dialogues.speaker: Strange Boxes
dialogues.text: (Old, decrepit heavy boxes covered in layers of dust. Their presence here in the usually bright and clear Court of Fontaine is quite jarring.)

dialogues.speaker: Strange Boxes
dialogues.text: (The bases of these boxes have collected a lot of clear water stains over the years. They must have once been piled in an exceedingly damp location.)

dialogues.speaker: Strange Boxes
dialogues.text: (Never mind the stains on the door — these boxes look to be in far more urgent need of a cleanup.)
